data_model.file_shape: { schemaVersion:string (real file = '1.0.0-real'), generatedAt:string, expectationModel:{ formula:string, a:number, b:number }, receivers: ReceiverWeekRow[] }
data_model.row_shape: ReceiverWeekRow = { playerId:string, playerName:string, team:string(abbrev), position:'WR'|'TE'|'RB', week:number, opponent:string(abbrev), gameId:string, openRate:0-1, targetShare:0-1, expectedTargetShare:0-1, toe:number(=targetShare-expectedTargetShare), openRateVsMan:0-1, openRateVsZone:0-1, targetShareVsMan:0-1, targetShareVsZone:0-1, routesRun:number, targets:number, receptions:number, yards:number }
data_model.shape_choice: Per-week rows (one row per player per week, weeks 1-8). Week filter and the Current Game/matchup quick filter work directly off week+gameId+opponent on each row. NOTE on gameId in the REAL data: it is the game key (e.g. '2021091207'), stable per game but NOT week-prefixed; availableGames(rows, week) scopes it per week. Field names/types are identical to src/lib/types.ts ReceiverWeekRow (verified against the real file).
data_model.expectation_formula: REAL data: per-row expectedTargetShare is a route-participation baseline = routesRun / teamRoutes(week), already stored on each row; toe = targetShare - expectedTargetShare (also stored). LATER FEATS MUST read expectedTargetShare and toe FROM THE ROW — do NOT recompute from a+b*openRate. The linear a/b (receivers.json.expectationModel, a=0.085037 b=0.067407, mirrored in src/lib/toe.ts defaultModel) is used ONLY to draw the headline scatter's diagonal expectation reference line (expectedTargetShareLine(openRate)) and as a fallback.
data_model.consistency_rules: Validated by scripts/check-data.mjs: exactly 32 real team abbreviations present (ARI ATL BAL BUF CAR CHI CIN CLE DAL DEN DET GB HOU IND JAX KC LV LAC LAR MIA MIN NE NO NYG NYJ PHI PIT SF SEA TB TEN WAS); weeks 1-8 all present; 50-1200 distinct players (real file has ~468); every row has all fields with correct types; all *Rate/*Share in [0,1]; receptions<=targets<=routesRun; toe == targetShare-expectedTargetShare within 5e-4 (rows rounded to 4dp). The real data spans WR/TE/RB and naturally includes alpha WR / slot / deep threat / checkdown RB / ignored role-player patterns.
data_model.swap_in_real_data: receivers.json ALREADY IS real data. To swap a different real feed in, replace public/data/receivers.json with a file of the same wrapper shape (same column names). No code changes. If the expectation model's a/b change, update expectationModel.a/.b in the JSON (and the mirror in src/lib/toe.ts defaultModel used for the reference line). The synthetic fallback lives at public/data/receivers.sample.json via `npm run generate-data`.
